Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French routine.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ruˈti.nə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ruˈti.na]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)

Noun

[edit]

rutina f (plural rutines)

  1. routine

Derived terms

[edit]
  • rutinari

Further reading

[edit]
  • “rutina”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “rutina”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “rutina” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “rutina” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Czech

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈrutɪna]

Noun

[edit]

rutina f

  1. skill, dexterity
  2. a set of normal procedures, often performed mechanically; a routine

Declension

[edit]

singular plural

genitive rutiny rutin

vocative rutino rutiny

instrumental rutinou rutinami

Esperanto

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From rutino +‎ -a.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ruˈtina/
  • Rhymes: -ina
  • Syllabification: ru‧ti‧na

Adjective

[edit]

rutina (accusative singular rutinan, plural rutinaj, accusative plural rutinajn)

  1. routine, habitual

Finnish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

rutista +‎ -na

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈrutinɑ/, [ˈrut̪inɑ̝]
  • Rhymes: -utinɑ
  • Syllabification(key): ru‧ti‧na
  • Hyphenation(key): ru‧ti‧na

Noun

[edit]

rutina

  1. crackle, crunch (sound of sand between gears).
  2. (colloquial) constant complaint

[edit]

[edit]

Borrowed from French routiner.

[edit]

a rutina (third-person singular present rutinează, past participle rutinat) 1st conjugation

  1. to make a routine

Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ruˈtina/ [ruˈt̪i.na]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ina
  • Syllabification: ru‧ti‧na

Etymology 1

[edit]

Borrowed from French routine.

Noun

[edit]

rutina f (plural rutinas)

  1. routine
  2. grind (colloquial)
Derived terms
[edit]
  • rutinario

Etymology 2

[edit]

From translingual Ruta +‎ -ina.

Noun

[edit]

rutina f (plural rutinas)

  1. rutin
